# Rework Combat Free Spins Progression

## Goal
Align combat progression with your intended loop:
- Base trigger comes from enough `cigarette` + `bloody hand` + `booze` activations.
- Initial free spins run fixed powers in sequence (`Love -> Star -> Storm`) instead of using current-princess selection.
- Ultimate free spins unlock only after a full grid clear where wild symbols do not block the clear condition.
- Remove/stop surfacing irrelevant `current princess` display from gameplay HUD/test harness.

## Current Mismatch (confirmed)
- Current flow still uses rotating active princess and default selection at free-spin entry in [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd):
```484:513:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd
func _run_trinity_round_async() -> Dictionary:
	var out := _empty_spin_summary()
	meter.saved_active_princess = princesses.current_id()
	multiplier.reset()
	_refresh_multiplier_label()
	_in_trinity_round = true
	var order: Array[StringName] = [&"love", &"star", &"storm"]
	# ...
	if _is_grid_empty():
		_pending_free_spins = true
```
- Debug/test UI still shows current princess in [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd) and [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn).

## Planned Implementation

### 1) Replace trigger model with premium-symbol activation tracking
- Add a small state object/counters in [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd) (or [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\meter.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\meter.gd) if preferred) to count cigarette/bloody-hand/booze activations from resolved wins.
- Define activation thresholds as exported values (easy tuning in inspector).
- Trigger initial free spins when all required premium counters meet threshold.

### 2) Introduce explicit Free Spins phases
- Extend [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\free_spins.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\free_spins.gd) with phases:
  - `inactive`
  - `base_sequence` (forced Love -> Star -> Storm ordering)
  - `ultimate_specialized` (player-selected focus power)
- Keep multiplier cap/remaining-spins logic, but decouple from `chosen_princess` as entry requirement.
- Add methods for:
  - starting base sequence spins,
  - stepping sequence order,
  - checking unlock condition,
  - promoting to ultimate specialized mode.

### 3) Gate ultimate mode by clear condition that ignores wilds
- Replace `_is_grid_empty()` checks with a new helper in [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd):
  - `is_non_wild_grid_cleared()` returns true when no non-wild symbols remain.
- Use this condition to unlock specialization after base sequence, matching your rule.

### 4) Remove irrelevant princess display in visible HUD/test scene
- Remove or repurpose `CurrentPrincessLabel` in [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn).
- Update [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd) readout to show free-spin phase + progress instead of current princess.
- Keep princess internals if still required by power implementations, but avoid surfacing it as player-facing state outside specialization context.

### 5) Update goals/tests/docs to new semantics
- Update goal and summary semantics in [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\goal_tracker.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\goal_tracker.gd) and relevant `goal_*.gd` files so free-spins goals align with new trigger/phase model.
- Adjust deterministic and princess checks in:
  - [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\determinism_check.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\determinism_check.gd)
  - [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\princess_check.gd](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\princess_check.gd)
- Revise design/implementation docs to remove contradictory “show active princess / choose on FS entry” guidance:
  - [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_combat_design.md](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_combat_design.md)
  - [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_combat_implementation.md](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_combat_implementation.md)

## Flow Diagram
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  spinResolve[SpinResolved] --> premiumTrack[UpdatePremiumActivationCounters]
  premiumTrack --> triggerCheck{AllThresholdsMet}
  triggerCheck -->|No| normalLoop[ContinueBaseCombatLoop]
  triggerCheck -->|Yes| baseFS[EnterBaseFreeSpins]
  baseFS --> seqPower[ApplyLoveStarStormSequence]
  seqPower --> clearCheck{NonWildGridCleared}
  clearCheck -->|No| baseFS
  clearCheck -->|Yes| chooseSpec[ChooseSpecialization]
  chooseSpec --> ultimateFS[EnterUltimateSpecializedFreeSpins]
  ultimateFS --> endNode[ExitToBaseOrEncounterEnd]
```

## Validation
- Run deterministic test twice with identical seed and compare final snapshot/state.
- Verify no UI label references “current princess” outside specialization choice UI.
- Verify free-spins entry only occurs after premium symbol activation thresholds.
- Verify ultimate unlock only when grid has no non-wild symbols remaining.

    - `x4` -> `+2`
    - `x5` -> full meter (`3/3`)

- In test UI:
  - `combat/scripts/combat_test.gd` now shows `Premium meter: X / 3` instead of `Current princess`.
  - `combat/combat_test.tscn` label text updated to `Premium meter: 0 / 3`.

- Lint check: no errors on edited scripts.
- Headless tests passed:
  - `res://combat/test/princess_check.gd`
  - `res://combat/test/determinism_check.gd`

- meter full -> Trinity sequence (`Love -> Star -> Storm`)
